purpose: Teach: 戦隊/唐辛子/車いす/垣根/熱海/ウェディング/アロハ/ミント

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様が戦隊ヒーローに夢中なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's child is absolutely obsessed with sentai heroes.
lines.style: Warm, easy observation delivered mid-task. Light, conversational tone—not reporting news, just sharing a detail she noticed and wants Aoi to know. Brief smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、唐辛子入りオリーブオイル使いましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should try that new chili-infused olive oil in the next menu.
lines.style: Bright, forward-looking energy. Words move quickly, lightly excited about the possibility. Leaning in slightly with the idea, not directive—collaborative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、車いすでお見えになるから、お席を準備しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's coming in a wheelchair, so let's make sure we have the right seat ready for them.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact care. No flourish—just attentive preparation spoken with quiet certainty. A statement that assumes Aoi will agree, not a question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前の垣根、整えたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I've been thinking about trimming back the hedge out front.
lines.style: Gentle, half-musing tone. Not a plan yet—more a thought turning over. Slight pause quality, like she's considering it aloud while working. Open to response.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、熱海の温泉旅行から帰ってこられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer just got back from a hot spring trip to Atami.
lines.style: Soft, interested sharing. Quiet warmth—the pleasure of knowing a regular's small joy. No urgency, just genuine notice of their life continuing outside the cafe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ウェディングプランナーのお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They work as a wedding planner, I think.
lines.style: Thoughtful, placing a piece. The tone of remembering something someone once said. A little admiration underneath—seeing the shape of their life.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハワイのお土産でアロハシャツくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They even gave me an aloha shirt from Hawaii as a gift.
lines.style: Gentle warmth with genuine pleasure. The slight lift of someone remembering kindness. Spoken as if she can still picture the moment, the generosity of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ミントレモネード作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make a mint lemonade for the new menu—something fresh.
lines.style: Energized, gently decisive. Words have forward momentum. The pleasure of creating something. Not commanding, but clear—Aoi will feel the draw of it.
